en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a busy waterfront with several steamships and small passenger boats on a wide river or harbor. In the foreground are docked boats with names painted on their sides, and in the background across the water is a tree‑lined shore with substantial masonry buildings, including a large domed structure with a lantern on top and a multi‑gabled institutional building, giving the impression of a northern European city waterfront.
